title: Equivalence of Common Metrics on Trapezoidal Fuzzy Numbers
content: In this paper, we show that the four kinds of common metrics: the supremum metric, the Lp-type dp metrics, the sendograph metric and the endograph metric, are equivalent on the trapezoidal fuzzy numbers. Furthermore, we point out that, on the trapezoidal fuzzy numbers, these four kinds of metric convergences are equivalent to the convergence of the corresponding representation quadruples of the trapezoidal fuzzy numbers in R^4.
